profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Platform & Full-Stack | Regulated Systems (Healthcare, Fintech)
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 9+ years of experience across platform engineering, developer tooling, and full-stack systems in regulated industries including fintech, healthcare, and government. I have built shared platform components, client SDKs, Snowflake and Databricks integrations, and production-grade services with a focus on reliability, developer experience, and maintainable systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack platform engineering for Amazon LEO's RF Systems Integration and Test (RFSIT) program, spanning real-time data visualization and hardware device control.
- Embedded with Amazon LEO's RF validation team, building automation infrastructure and internal tooling for bring-up, integration, and test of satellite communication systems.
- Owned backend device integration for RF test hardware: driver bring-up, TCP/UDP/IP communication layers, and data pipeline reliability across lab equipment and internal systems.
- Developed full-stack UI (AWS, React, FastAPI, Python) for real-time RF data visualization during live drive tests, supporting root-cause analysis and system-level characterization.
- Built and maintained Python/bash-based test automation frameworks and CI/CD deployment pipelines for an in-house RF validation product.
- Partnered cross-functionally with RF, PHY, and systems engineers to support test execution and debugging at scale across Amazon Leo's satellite vehicle testing program.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built shared TypeScript platform components and an open-source Python client SDK supporting Capital One Software’s data platform.
- Built integrations for an ML-based optimization system delivering automated Databricks job cost reductions.
- Delivered reusable React widgets and integrations for Snowflake and Databricks users, enabling consistent UI patterns and faster feature delivery.
- Owned features end-to-end from requirements and design reviews through implementation, release, and production support.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Developed frontend and backend services using TypeScript (React, Node.js, AWS Lambda) supporting healthcare FHIR data extraction operations against EHR systems.
- Implemented refresh token and access token authentication flows to enable SSO integrations with external hospital systems.
- Improved platform reliability and correctness through production ownership, incident triage, and performance improvements.
- Delivered full-stack features across REST APIs, data flows, and operational tooling to support clinical data ingestion and serving.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Contract)
positions.description:
- At Replay.io: Reduced non-deterministic Firefox browser state (C++) and built Python CI/CD automation tooling; reduced
compile times by 44%.
- Reduced AWS S3 costs by 15% by improving scaling of Kubernetes-based archival infrastructure.
- At Steampunk: Built Docker-containerized Ruby on Rails backend services and React features supporting federal refugee
and asylee application processing for USCIS.
positions.insights: Ruby on Rails, React.js and +7 skills

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built full-stack TypeScript (React, Node.js) features for agricultural data analytics workflows.
- Led design and implementation of a tile-based rendering pipeline projecting telemetric data onto geospatial field
boundaries.
- Built external API integrations with John Deere and Farmobile to ingest and normalize field data.
